candidates.title: The Real Date Starts After We Leave
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu and Zuv leave a social thing and immediately begin the private couple debrief: who was sweet, who was weird, what they both noticed but could not say out loud.
candidates.suggested_text_hook: the real date starts after we leave.
candidates.why_people_may_share: Couples send this because the post names a private ritual they rarely admit: the ride home is half romance, half joint investigation.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: It baits warm comments like 'we need 45 minutes after every party' and 'he knows exactly when the debrief face starts.'
candidates.likely_audience_reaction: Immediate tag: 'this is literally us after meeting anyone.'

candidates.title: We Said We're Leaving
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu says they are leaving, Zuv says yes, and then both enter the sacred 18-minute pre-exit ritual: water, keys, one last mirror check, charger, lights, shoes, back for something forgotten.
candidates.suggested_text_hook: we said we're leaving. that was the beginning of leaving.
candidates.why_people_may_share: Every couple has one person who thinks 'leaving' is a decision and one who knows it is a process.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: It invites comments like 'add finding the keys' and 'ours is minimum 23 minutes.'
candidates.likely_audience_reaction: A laughing accusation sent to the partner who delays every exit.

candidates.title: Assigned Seats, Denied Publicly
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu and Zuv insist they are normal people, but the sofa, cafe bench, and bed all know exactly whose side is whose.
candidates.suggested_text_hook: we don't have assigned seats. we absolutely have assigned seats.
candidates.why_people_may_share: People will send it because it turns a tiny domestic habit into a couple identity test.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: It baits harmless territory comments: 'left side forever,' 'he took my spot once and I changed as a person.'
candidates.likely_audience_reaction: Fast recognition from couples with unspoken home rules.

candidates.title: No-Context Screenshot Department
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu sends Zuv a screenshot with only 'thoughts?' and he somehow understands the full emotional, financial, aesthetic, and future-life context.
candidates.suggested_text_hook: relationship stage: 'thoughts?' is a complete sentence.
candidates.why_people_may_share: The person who receives unexplained screenshots knows they are being invited into a tiny decision ceremony.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: It invites 'I'm the screenshot person' versus 'I'm the three-paragraph reply person' comments.
candidates.likely_audience_reaction: A tag with zero explanation, which proves the idea.

candidates.title: Fan Speed 2.5
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu and Zuv negotiate the fan, blanket, window, and one-foot-out compromise like two diplomats trying to sleep in the same weather system.
candidates.suggested_text_hook: true love is agreeing on fan speed 2.5.
candidates.why_people_may_share: Temperature politics are intimate, daily, and funny without being mean.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: It baits easy team comments: 'fan 5 or nothing,' 'blanket even in June,' 'one foot out gang.'
candidates.likely_audience_reaction: A partner gets tagged with 'you are impossible to sleep beside.'

candidates.title: The Last Bite Summit
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu and Zuv pretend to be generous over the last bite of dessert, while both clearly know this is a negotiation with witnesses.
candidates.suggested_text_hook: we don't split dessert. we hold negotiations.
candidates.why_people_may_share: Every couple has a last-bite liar, a last-bite martyr, or a last-bite thief.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: It invites confessions: 'I say I'm full and then stare,' 'he cuts the last bite into two tragic crumbs.'

top_pick.title: The Real Date Starts After We Leave
top_pick.why: It has the cleanest three-second hook and the strongest send behavior: one partner can forward it without adding anything.
top_pick.primary_send_trigger: Tag the person you silently debrief every social event with.
top_pick.warm_comment_bait: Who starts the debrief first, and how long does yours last?

engagement_rationale.core_strategy: Prioritize recognition that creates a private couple accusation: this is us and you know it.
engagement_rationale.metric_logic: These ideas are built for sends per 1k and follow conversion rather than passive likes.

distribution_risks.risk: Some concepts could become generic if staged as quote cards.
distribution_risks.mitigation: Make each slide prove the behavior visually through Aachu and Zuv's body language, props, and tiny domestic specificity.

distribution_risks.risk: Temperature and leaving-delay ideas can drift into one-sided stereotypes.
No-context screenshot can feel too phone-led if overdone.
distribution_risks.mitigation: Use the phone only as the trigger, then show the real couple decision unfolding in the room.
